result.summary: Bounded repair 2 delivered as one unified diff (496 lines, 3 context lines, trailing newline) touching exactly godot/scripts/core/construction.gd (append region only) and godot/scripts/core/save_owner_construction.gd. B1: adds an independent OWNER_FIELD_BEGIN=29 literal and checks the actual Schema.OWNER_FIELD_BEGIN[1] plus its column extent inside _identity_refusal, which runs only after gate 3 has forwarded Schema.schema_refusal. B2: adds five independent out-of-file anchors (SOURCE_B_WORK_MWU=2, SOURCE_B_MAX_BUILDERS=9, SOURCE_B_FIELD_COUNT=10, SOURCE_F_WORK_MWU=2, SOURCE_F_FIELD_COUNT=4) and compares each against BOTH the live BuildingDefinitions constant and Construction's own SOURCE_* mirror, so a coordinated source-plus-mirror rearrangement cannot pass. B3: _scalar_anchor_refusal is decomposed into _capacity/_reference/_purpose/_phase/_phase_tail/_refund/_domain/_fact_index/_furniture_index groups over a shared _anchor formatter; all 58 pre-existing scalar comparisons are preserved in their original order and detail wording, the dynamic array-of-arrays check table is gone in favour of explicit comparisons, and every new helper body is under 30 code lines. Owner append region: Columns._init returns on allocate_defaults==false BEFORE any helper or allocation and then calls new _resize_columns/_fill_clear_values helpers; column_source_metadata_refusal keeps its unchanged three-line _source_scalar_refusal opening and delegates to _gate_array_extents_ok, _source_dictionary_extents_ok and _source_row_scan_refusal in the identical order, with fail-before-index retained. No refusal codes, frozen values, gate order, detail prefixes, projection mapping, public API or the original gameplay prefix change; no docs, tests or UID files are touched. Nothing was run, applied or accepted.
